 Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live US stocks rebound as rumors of SpaceX-Tesla merger loom
 Wall Street shares are making a strong start this Wednesday, largely boosted by the tech industry after earnings results from Elon Musk's SpaceX restored some confidence in the outlook for AI spending. That report came amid speculation of a potential Musk mega-merger between SpaceX and Tesla.
